steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Line equations: y - y₁ = m(x - x₁) or y = mx + c

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Find the equation of the circle with diameter endpoints A(1,2) and B(5,6). Find the tangent at A. --- Solution: Centre = midpoint of AB = (3,4). Radius = half of AB = ½sqrt((5-1)^2+(6-2)^2) = ½sqrt32 = 2sqrt2. Circle: (x-3)^2+(y-4)^2=8. Gradient of radius OA = (2-4)/(1-3)=1. Tangent gradient = -1. Tangent at A: y-2 = -1(x-1) -> y = -x+3

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Find the line through (-2,3) perpendicular to 2x + 3y = 6 | Find intersection of y = 2x - 1 and 3x + y = 7 | Circle C: (x-2)^2 + (y+1)^2 = 25. Find tangent at (5,3)

steps.title: Lesson plan
steps.body: Starter (5 min): Recall prior knowledge of coordinate geometry with quick questions. Teaching (15 min): Work through each of the learning objectives, explaining principles step by step. Key points review (5 min): Revisit the key points together, confirming understanding. Worked example (10 min): Model the example question: Find the equation of the circle with diameter endpoints A(1,2) and B(5,6). Find the tangent at A.. Solution: Centre = midpoint of AB = (3,4). Radius = half of AB = ½sqrt((5-1)^2+(6-2)^2) = ½sqrt32 = 2sqrt2. Circle: (x-3)^2+(y-4)^2=8. Gradient of radius OA = (2-4)/(1-3)=1. Tangent gradient = -1.
